encoding: Go encoding/json.Marshal(map) as strict C2 body; no BOM/newline; duplicate keys, invalid UTF8/surrogates, floats, NaN and infinities rejected before encoding
bodyKeys: Every body key in the relevant closed schema, excluding the outer signer. No fixture wrapper enters a signed body.
envelopeSHA256: SHA256(canonical({body,signer})); exact canonical bytes, no newline
signerBinding: Ed25519 role plus independently pinned registered public SPKI hash; signer roles never grant trust by themselves; no Node leaf used to sign Root/fence/inventory objects
syntheticSignaturePolicy: Signature-shaped fixture hex is INVALID/UNTRUSTED, never produced by signing and never an acceptance proof
